_note: Example of the responses file format. The first two answers pass. The third sends a number as a string, so it fails on purpose. Cases without a response count as failed.

_raw_example.note: Optional raw field, not part of the responses above. raw holds the model's original call, where qty is the string "5". tool_calls holds the normalized call, where qty is 5. The runner scores raw, so it fails a case that needs a number, and the report marks adapter_diff.
